question_set.question: Use highlight_category with field equal to field, values equal to Product_importance and use hide_dimensions with dimensions equal to hide, mode equal to hide and use filter_by_category with field equal to dimensions, values equal to Customer_rating, Cost_of_the_Product in order to know How do customer engagement patterns differ across product importance levels? Analyze the relationship between customer care calls, ratings, and purchase behavior to understand what distinguishes high-importance products from others.

answer.value: High-importance products show distinct customer engagement patterns. They have the lowest average customer care calls (0.374 normalized) compared to medium (0.406) and low (0.422), suggesting customers have fewer issues with high-importance products. However, high-importance products receive slightly higher discounts (0.214) and have more prior purchases (0.207), indicating they are established products with loyal customer bases. Customer ratings remain consistent across all importance levels (around 0.496-0.499), while cost decreases slightly with importance (low: 0.542, medium: 0.530, high: 0.504). High-discount products are predominantly low and medium importance (89.8%), while high-importance products represent only 10.1% of heavily discounted items, suggesting pricing strategies differ by importance level.

key_insights: High-importance products have lowest customer care calls (0.374)
High-importance products receive higher discounts (0.214) and have more prior purchases (0.207)
Customer ratings remain consistent across all importance levels
High-discount products are predominantly low and medium importance (89.8%)
